name: Rock Islands Southern Lagoon
description: In Palau's southern lagoon, between Koror and Peleliu, 445 uninhabited limestone islands rise from turquoise water, many worn into mushroom shapes. Coral reefs with over 385 species surround them, and the islands hold the world's densest cluster of marine lakes, which are isolated pools of seawater that still yield new species. Stonework villages and rock art reveal about three thousand years of island life.
